name: heat_pump_scroll_compressor_data_check
title: Scroll-compressor heat pump on R407C: data consistency check
summary: Vapour-compression heat-pump operating point on R407C rebuilt from the capacities and powers announced by a scroll-compressor manufacturer: mass flow rate, swept volume, compressor duties, isentropic efficiency of the compressor and global isentropic efficiency of the machine, compared with the announced data.

authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise)
origin.course: ULiège, "Machines et systèmes thermiques", repetition session 8, exercise 5 (header VL050415, 2005-04-15)

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/refrigeration3.EES, EES X7.210), read from its solution report EES_ok/refrigeration3.tex; for the _coolsolve variant, whose native file is blocked by CS-GAP-PROP-TH
verification.notes: 30 common variables, 1 differ (rtol=1e-3): P_4 (3.6e-3), a (T,H) inversion in EES vs a (P,H) inversion in the variant, inside the saturation dome. The 29 other variables agree within 9.7e-4 (rho_1). The 17 variables only in CoolSolve are the P[i]/h[i]/T[i]/s[i] array elements (T[i], s[i] added on import) and the auxiliary T_4 of the variant. The decoded binary variable records of the EES file are stale (CS-BUG-EXTRACT-STALE), so the .tex solution report is used as the reference. No unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/refrigeration3.eescode (same exercise, kept in CoolSolve as a test case; its state-4 line equates an enthalpy with a pressure and is superseded by the original here)
CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip: EES_ok/refrigeration3.EES (original French EES file, stored solution) and EES_ok/refrigeration3.tex (EES solution report used as verification reference)
